form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where the data comes from: a database reached by JDBC, Amazon Athena through the AWS SDK, an LDAP directory, or CSV or an Excel workbook held in this document. Queries of a JDBC or Athena source give their SQL in a sql clause, and queries of an LDAP directory their search filter; CSV and Excel are queried with Stroom's own clauses.

form:FormGroup.label: JDBC URL
form:FormGroup.helpText: The JDBC URL of the database, e.g. jdbc:mysql://reporting-db:3306/reports. It must match one of the patterns an administrator has allowed in the dataConnection.allowedUrlPatterns property. Do not put a user name or password in it; choose a credential instead.

form:FormGroup.label: Credential
form:FormGroup.helpText: The username and password credential to connect with. You need Use permission on it, as does anyone who queries this data source. Use a database account that can only read: Stroom asks for read-only connections, but only the database can enforce it.

form:FormGroup.label: Connection Properties
form:FormGroup.helpText: Extra JDBC driver properties, one name=value per line. For MySQL, add useCursorFetch=true so large results are read in batches of the fetch size rather than all at once. Properties that can read files, load classes or turn off read-only connections are refused.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Pool Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most connections Stroom keeps open to this database at once. An administrator may set a lower ceiling. Default: 5

form:FormGroup.label: Fetch Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many rows are fetched from the database in each round trip. 0 uses the driver's own default. Default: 1000

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum Refresh (minutes)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The shortest interval at which a dashboard may rerun a query of this data source automatically, to limit the load on the database. 0 sets no minimum beyond the dashboard's own 10 seconds. Default: 0

form:FormGroup.label: AWS Region
form:FormGroup.helpText: The AWS region of the Athena workgroup, e.g. eu-west-2.

form:FormGroup.label: Workgroup
form:FormGroup.helpText: The Athena workgroup queries run in. The region and workgroup must match one of the patterns an administrator has allowed in the dataConnection.allowedAthenaWorkGroups property. The workgroup's per-query data scan limit is the control on cost. Default: primary

form:FormGroup.label: Data Catalog
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data catalog queries run in. Default: AwsDataCatalog

form:FormGroup.label: Database
form:FormGroup.helpText: The database queries run in. Default: default

form:FormGroup.label: Output Location (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The S3 URI query results are written to, e.g. s3://my-bucket/athena/. Leave empty to use the workgroup's. It must match one of the patterns an administrator has allowed in the dataConnection.allowedAthenaOutputLocations property.

form:FormGroup.label: Credential
form:FormGroup.helpText: The AWS access key credential to query with. You need Use permission on it, as does anyone who queries this data source. With none, Stroom's own AWS identity is used, if an administrator has turned on dataConnection.allowDefaultAwsCredentials. Use an identity that can only read the tables Stroom should query.

form:FormGroup.label: Result Reuse (minutes)
form:FormGroup.helpText: How old a result of the same query may be and still be reused instead of running the query again. Athena bills every run, so this saves cost when a dashboard is refreshed. 0 never reuses a result. Default: 0

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum Refresh (minutes)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The shortest interval at which a dashboard may rerun a query of this data source automatically. Every Athena run is billed by the data it scans, and result reuse rarely helps a dashboard, as its time range changes on every refresh. Many refreshes also use up the account's limit on Athena queries running at once. 0 sets no minimum beyond the dashboard's own 10 seconds. Default: 5

form:FormGroup.label: Max Data Scanned (MB)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most data, in MB, a query may scan in Athena before Stroom stops it; Athena bills by the data a query scans. Stroom checks while the query runs, so a query may pass the limit by what it scans between two checks. The workgroup's own per-query data scan limit is the one Athena enforces exactly, so set that too. 0 sets no limit beyond the workgroup's. Default: 0

form:FormGroup.label: LDAP URL
form:FormGroup.helpText: The directory's URL: its scheme, host and port only, e.g. ldaps://directory.example.org:636. It must match one of the patterns an administrator has allowed in the dataConnection.allowedLdapUrlPatterns property. The certificate must be trusted by Stroom's Java trust store and name the host.

Whether to start TLS on an ldap:// connection before binding, so the password and results are encrypted. An ldaps:// connection is always encrypted. Plain ldap:// without StartTLS can only be used if an administrator turns on dataConnection.allowPlainLdap. Default: off

form:FormGroup.label: Credential
form:FormGroup.helpText: The username and password credential to bind with: its username is the bind DN, e.g. cn=stroom-reader,ou=Services,dc=example,dc=org. You need Use permission on it, as does anyone who queries this data source. Anonymous binds are not allowed. Use an account that can only read the entries and attributes Stroom needs, as directories hold personal data.

form:FormGroup.label: Base DN
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where searches start, e.g. ou=People,dc=example,dc=org. Queries cannot search outside it.

form:FormGroup.label: Scope
form:FormGroup.helpText: How far below the base DN searches reach: the base entry only, the entries directly below it, or the whole subtree. Default: the whole subtree

form:FormGroup.label: Page Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many entries are fetched in each page of results. The directory's own size limit for the bind account still applies, and ends a search early with a warning. Default: 500

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum Refresh (minutes)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The shortest interval at which a dashboard may rerun a query of this data source automatically, to limit the load on the directory. 0 sets no minimum beyond the dashboard's own 10 seconds. Default: 0

form:FormGroup.label: Attributes
form:FormGroup.helpText: The attributes read from each entry. Each becomes a query field of the same name, after dn, which every entry has. An attribute an entry lacks is empty. Text joins several values with '; '; other types need a single value, and a value that is not of its type is empty, and the query warns. Date reads LDAP times and Active Directory's FILETIME numbers. Detect Attributes lists those of the first 100 entries, keeping a type you set here; add others, such as operational attributes, by name.

form:FormGroup.label: Delimiter
form:FormGroup.helpText: The character between the values of each row.
Whether the first row holds the column names. Without it, columns are named column1, column2 and so on. Default: on

form:FormGroup.label: CSV
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data, pasted here or read from a file on your computer with Load From File. It is held in this document and is queried as it stands when saved. An administrator sets the most it may hold with the dataConnection.maxStoredDataSize property, so keep it to lookup tables and reference lists; bulk data belongs in a feed.

form:FormGroup.label: Columns
form:FormGroup.helpText: The columns, in the order their values appear in each row. Each becomes a query field of the same name, read as its type; a value that is not of its column's type is empty, and the query warns. Detect Columns names them from the header row and guesses each type from the values, keeping a type you set here for a column of the same name.

form:FormGroup.label: Workbook
form:FormGroup.helpText: The Excel .xlsx workbook, held in this document and queried as it stood when saved. Choose a file: it is uploaded straight away, and stored with the document when you save. Older .xls workbooks cannot be read; save them as .xlsx in Excel first. An administrator sets the most it may hold with the dataConnection.maxStoredDataSize property, so keep it to lookup tables and reference lists; bulk data belongs in a feed.

form:FormGroup.label: Sheet (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the sheet to read. Leave empty to read the first sheet.
Whether the first row with values holds the column names. Without it, columns are named column1, column2 and so on. Default: on

form:FormGroup.label: Columns
form:FormGroup.helpText: The columns, in the order their values appear in each row. Each becomes a query field of the same name, read as its type; a value that is not of its column's type is empty, and the query warns. Numbers are read as plain numbers, whatever their format in Excel, dates as dates, and formulas as the value Excel last worked out. Detect Columns names them from the header row and guesses each type from the values, keeping a type you set here for a column of the same name.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Column (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: A date column of the data. When a query has a time range, rows are filtered on this column in Stroom. For JDBC and LDAP this is only done when the SQL or filter has no :from or :to placeholder; for LDAP, CSV and Excel it must be a Date column or attribute. With none, the time range is ignored and the query says so.

form:FormGroup.label: Query Timeout (seconds)
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a query may run before it is stopped. An administrator may set a lower ceiling. Default: 60

form:FormGroup.label: Max Rows
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most rows a query may read; a query with more uses the first ones and says so. An administrator may set a lower ceiling. Default: 100000
